exercises.why: The genitive case has four main uses: to denote possession ('Michael's car', meaning 'the car of Michael'), to denote number ('five apples'), in negative constructions ('there are no books'), and after several important prepositions ('without me'). — From the Wikibooks Russian textbook (CC BY-SA 4.0).
